// Request descriptors are not signed transactions. Route View to the view API;
// route lifecycle hooks through activation/upgrade, and Kotoage through the call API.
// The application must verify codeHash against the target's active binding before use.
import { KotodamaInt, KotodamaDecimal, KotodamaQuantity, NumericV1 } from "@iroha/iroha-js";
import type { ContractEntrypointArgumentSchema, ContractEntrypointValueType } from "@iroha/iroha-js";

export type JsonValue = null | boolean | number | string | readonly JsonValue[] | { readonly [key: string]: JsonValue };
export type OptionValue<T> = { readonly some: T } | { readonly none: true };
export type ResultValue<T, E> = { readonly ok: T } | { readonly err: E };
interface RequestData<T> {
  readonly codeHash: string;
  readonly ordinal: number;
  readonly entrypoint: string;
  readonly payload: JsonValue;
  readonly argumentSchema: ContractEntrypointArgumentSchema | null;
  readonly returnSchema: ContractEntrypointValueType;
  readonly decodeResult: (value: unknown) => T;
}
export interface ViewRequest<T> extends RequestData<T> { readonly kind: "View" }
export interface KotoageRequest<T> extends RequestData<T> { readonly kind: "Kotoage" }
export interface HajimariRequest<T> extends RequestData<T> { readonly kind: "Hajimari" }
export interface KaizenRequest<T> extends RequestData<T> { readonly kind: "Kaizen" }
function fail(): never { throw new TypeError("Value does not match the signed Kotodama schema"); }
function string(value: unknown): string {
  if (typeof value !== "string") return fail();
  for (let i = 0; i < value.length; i += 1) {
    const unit = value.charCodeAt(i);
    if (unit >= 0xd800 && unit <= 0xdbff) {
      const low = value.charCodeAt(++i);
      if (!(low >= 0xdc00 && low <= 0xdfff)) return fail();
    } else if (unit >= 0xdc00 && unit <= 0xdfff) return fail();
  }
  return value;
}
function boolean(value: unknown): boolean { if (typeof value !== "boolean") return fail(); return value; }
function bytes(value: unknown): string {
  const text = string(value);
  if (!text.startsWith("0x") || text.length % 2 !== 0 || /[^0-9a-f]/.test(text.slice(2))) return fail();
  return text;
}
// The JavaScript SDK's JSON profile deliberately limits DataSpaceId to safe JSON integers.
function dataspace(value: unknown): number {
  if (typeof value !== "number" || !Number.isSafeInteger(value) || value < 0 || Object.is(value, -0)) return fail();
  return value;
}
function record(value: unknown, keys?: readonly string[]): Map<string, unknown> {
  if (typeof value !== "object" || value === null || Array.isArray(value)) return fail();
  if (Object.getPrototypeOf(value) !== Object.prototype && Object.getPrototypeOf(value) !== null) return fail();
  const fields = new Map<string, unknown>();
  for (const key of Reflect.ownKeys(value)) {
    if (typeof key !== "string") return fail();
    const descriptor = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(value, key);
    if (!descriptor || !descriptor.enumerable || !("value" in descriptor)) return fail();
    fields.set(string(key), descriptor.value);
  }
  if (keys && (keys.length !== fields.size || keys.some(key => !fields.has(key)))) return fail();
  return fields;
}
function array(value: unknown, length: number, exact: boolean): unknown[] {
  if (!Array.isArray(value) || Object.getPrototypeOf(value) !== Array.prototype) return fail();
  if (exact ? value.length !== length : value.length > length) return fail();
  if (Reflect.ownKeys(value).length !== value.length + 1) return fail();
  for (let i = 0; i < value.length; i += 1) {
    const descriptor = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(value, String(i));
    if (!descriptor || !descriptor.enumerable || !("value" in descriptor)) return fail();
  }
  return value;
}
function object(entries: readonly (readonly [string, JsonValue])[]): { [key: string]: JsonValue } {
  const result: { [key: string]: JsonValue } = Object.create(null);
  for (const [key, value] of entries) Object.defineProperty(result, key, {value, enumerable: true});
  return result;
}
function json(value: unknown, depth = 0, budget = {left: 1_000_000}): JsonValue {
  if (depth > 128 || --budget.left < 0) return fail();
  if (value === null || typeof value === "boolean") return value;
  if (typeof value === "string") return string(value);
  if (typeof value === "number") { if (!Number.isSafeInteger(value) || Object.is(value, -0)) return fail(); return value; }
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return array(value, 1_000_000, false).map(item => json(item, depth + 1, budget));
  return object([...record(value)].map(([key, item]) => [key, json(item, depth + 1, budget)]));
}
